sentences: Rafe got to the bakery at four, an hour before the ovens needed him.
The dough from last night had risen against the cling film in soft gray domes.
The kitchen was a kaleidoscope of flour dust and copper light, a testament to forty years of early mornings.
He punched down the first tub and turned it out onto the bench.
Mina came in at half past, shaking rain off her hood.
She wanted to tell him about the letter from the landlord, about the rent, about the date in the second paragraph.
He punched down the second tub and turned it out onto the bench.
A wave of tiredness washed over him.
Mina picked up a scraper and started dividing the dough into twelve pieces.
She did not mention the letter. She did not mention the rent.
The timer went off, and he pulled out the first tray of rye.
In the end, it was never really about the bread, it was about who stayed to bake it.
